@graph.name: Assistance Services | Travel Guard
@graph.description: From gift wrapping to medical evacuation, our assistance services team is trained to help you with your travel needs.

@graph.name: Travel Guard Assistance Services
@graph.description: Travel Guard's assistance services team is trained to help with travel needs ranging from flight and hotel rebooking to emergency medical evacuation, available to travelers with Travel Guard plans.

itemOffered.name: Emergency Travel Assistance
itemOffered.description: Flight rebooking, hotel rebooking, rental car reservations, ATM locator, lost or stolen baggage, lost passport/travel documents assistance, emergency return travel arrangements, and missed connection coordination.

itemOffered.name: Travel Medical Assistance
itemOffered.description: Health care facility location, coordinating medically necessary return travel arrangements, assistance finding an English-speaking doctor, emergency medical evacuation, translation assistance, medical monitoring, prescription refill assistance, and medical equipment rental/replacement.

itemOffered.name: Concierge Assistance
itemOffered.description: Ground transportation coordination, restaurant referrals and reservations, event ticketing, golf tee time reservations and referrals, local activity recommendations, and floral services.

itemOffered.name: Roadside Assistance
itemOffered.description: Towing assistance, flat tire assistance, oil, fluid, and water delivery service, fuel delivery service, lock-out assistance, battery assistance, and collision assistance.

itemOffered.name: Personal Security Assistance
itemOffered.description: Emergency and security evacuations, 24/7 updates, collaboration with law enforcement, coordination of consultants to extract clients to safety, security intelligence, and 24/7/365 response services.

itemOffered.name: Worldwide Travel Assistance
itemOffered.description: Emergency cash transfer assistance, travel information including visa/passport requirements, up-to-the-minute travel delay reports, currency conversion or purchase, up-to-the-minute travel supplier strike information, legal referrals/bail bond assistance, and worldwide public holiday information.

itemOffered.name: Identity Theft Assistance
itemOffered.description: Credit bureau records, financial account investigation, communication to creditors, and work with law enforcement.
